entries.value: The former seat of a Roman provincial government
A trade nexus that has greatly prospered
An industrial or productive centre — iron, cloth, grain
Heavy resource extraction nearby — timber, lead, tin
It controls a vital defensive point — ford, pass, harbour
It is built around a working Roman aqueduct, road network, or structure
A stronghold of a significant local culture or ethnic minority
A sacred city to an important faith — seat of a bishop or monastery
A shared market for the many villages of a fertile region
A place of great natural beauty or unusual healthfulness
A shelter from dangerous surrounding lands
The inhabitants are somehow bound here by custom, oath, or fear
